styles.name: Soft Form
styles.coreTrick: Fill every surface with the canvas colour itself and let a paired dark/light shadow (offset down-right / up-left, derived from the canvas) make it look raised or recessed, with one iridescent glass panel and one glossy primary.
styles.colourRecipe: Canvas is pulled 6% (light) or 4% (dark) toward ink. Primary appears only on the single glossy CTA, switch knob, one swatch pad and checked boxes; ink fills the selected segment and slider fill (55%). hi = white@.79 and lo = canvas mixed 25% to black@.6 (dark: white@.11 and black@.53, app .13/.8 plus 1px top rim). Muted is pulled toward ink to 4.6:1 on every surface; the highlight word is the accent shaded to 3:1 (yellows fall back to the shaded primary). A muted or pastel primary still works because the on-state knob gets a ring mixed 45% toward ink.

styles.notes: Exact recipe: raised 6px 6px 13px lo, -6px -6px 13px hi (small 3/7); inset 6/13 (small 3/6); app raised 5/12, inset 4/9 and 2/5. Radii 24 card, 22 wells/trays/app card, 12 field/seg track (14 in app), 10 CTA (12 app), 9 selected segment, 10 mark. Glass ring 1.5px; glass disc 84px. Light direction fixed top-left, no motion. Soft Form is the planned rebuild target: the moves above cover board and kit; the lens and highlight fallback must be built as bespoke helpers or omitted in the rebuild.

styles.name: Retro-Futurist
styles.coreTrick: A lit white field with one flat signal colour, extended uppercase type, a three-stripe band as the rule and card edge, and gauge components (LED ladders, lamps, dials), headlined by a full-bleed procedural planet-and-orbit plate.
styles.colourRecipe: Canvas is white mixed 15% with the brand canvas (dark: #08090b), never tinted by the primary. Primary is nudged toward ink until it holds 3:1 and becomes the only chromatic mark; ink is flat; secondary and accent appear only in the stripe band and the accent orbit. A hot orange (#D93A12 / #FF7A4D) is reserved for the alert lamp. A muted primary still yields a signal because it is darkened to 3:1.

styles.name: Riso Print
styles.coreTrick: Two brand colours act as riso inks: they overprint with multiply, sit a few px off-register as hard plate shadows and offset outlines, and shade with halftone dots on grainy cream paper, with a fluorescent third ink used tiny.
styles.colourRecipe: Light canvas is replaced by fixed paper #F4EBDA; dark keeps the brand canvas and switches blend to screen. Primary is the headline ink, CTA block and selected state; secondary is the off-register plate (multiplied with the paper, or mixed 40% in dark); accent is replaced by a fixed fluorescent pink (#FF48B0) or orange (#FF7A1A if primary hue is >=300 or <=20). Muted is pulled toward ink to 4.7:1. A pale or muted primary prints weakly but remains legible since text uses ink and primary-text.

styles.name: Tab Stack
styles.coreTrick: Rounded colour cards (five brand-derived colours, all carrying one near-black text colour) tuck under each other like index tabs, with condensed capitals, mono details, white pills and circular arrow chips on a charcoal or sage ground.
styles.colourRecipe: Canvas is a charcoal tinted by the primary hue (dark) or a pale sage leaning 25% toward the primary hue (light), nudged to 7:1 against ink. The five card colours are the brand's distinct hues (primary, secondary, accent if >=24 deg apart and s>=12) plus rotated companions to five, lightness raised until near-black reads at 7:1; primary is printed as card A. On a greyscale brand the cards stay grey. Light mode pushes the printed primary deeper to 3.2:1 on the sage ground.

remainder.whyCode: Colour search loops with fallbacks for grey brands

styles.notes: Board and website only for the stack art and doodles; app has no art. Note the kit signature block (Round 14) makes the app kit more bespoke than the board, so moveCoverage there is lower.

styles.name: Tonal Shape
styles.coreTrick: Build elevation from tone steps of the primary mixed into the canvas (no borders or shadows), pill controls that squish on press, and one hash-chosen signature shape per brand used as the avatar, icon-button and list-icon container.
styles.colourRecipe: Canvas is a 4% (light) / 6% (dark, over a half-blackened canvas) tint of the primary tone. Low/mid/high containers are the tone mixed 4.5/8.5/15% into the ground; primary-container a 30% tint (dark 50% of a deepened tone) with on-text solved to 7:1; secondary-container 26% and accent tint 42%. Muted must hold 4.6:1 on all six beds; the outline is ink pulled toward the ground to 3.1:1. A neutral primary stays grey (low saturation is kept).
